verdict: The render is faithful in geometry, topology and labels; the only visible difference is that the centre dot at O is noticeably smaller than in the original.

issues.description: The filled dot at centre O is too small in the render. In the original it is a clearly bold dot of roughly twice the radius.
issues.suggestion: Increase the fill radius in \fill (O) circle (2.000pt); to about 3.5pt to 4pt to match the original dot size.
